elements.char: To appreciate the value of the dataset size, we study how model performance scales with the
elements.label: text

elements.char: amount of data used to train a model. To this end, we trained several U-Net models with varying
elements.label: text

elements.char: model capacities on different sized subsets of the training data. Figure 8 shows the SSIM metric
elements.label: text

elements.char: computed on the validation data for the multi-coil task. It is evident from these results that training
elements.label: text

elements.char: with larger amounts of data yields substantial improvements in the quality of reconstructions, which
elements.label: text

elements.char: highlights the need for the release of large datasets like fastMRI.
elements.label: text

elements.char: As mentioned in Section 4.5, the fastMRI dataset also includes a large set of DICOM images
elements.label: text

elements.char: that can be used as additional training data. It is possible that the baseline U-Net models could
elements.label: text

elements.char: be improved further by making use of this additional data.
